subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Is source-level terminal proof plus focused regression coverage sufficient to merge this classifier-only fix, or should this PR wait for live WhatsApp/OpenRouter transport proof?
rationale: The patch is narrow and code-backed, but it changes a final message-delivery classifier and the original report was a live channel send miss.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the before/after fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this classifier-only delivery-path fix.

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof
options.body: Pause until a redacted live channel transcript or log shows an `update_plan` turn followed by a `stopReason=stop` final answer being delivered.

recommendation.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the before/after fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this classifier-only delivery-path fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent terminal-classifier authorship and merge history make this the best available routing owner for the proof-bar decision.
